scope: Production AppKit panel compiled independently of the Flutter engine

constrain_frame_rect_comparison.method: Deterministic direct calls to the actual NSPanel subclass; no real input injection

regressions_covered: Native drag frame passes across display boundaries without the former upper-edge constraint
Global AppKit point coordinates, negative origins, unequal heights and offset screens
Fully visible card across a flush seam keeps its origin
A partially off-desktop card restores all controls on drop
Resize during drag preserves the actual AppKit-adopted origin; placement restores afterward
Ordinary ticks and pause preserve the panel frame
Existing theme, glyph-centering, long-duration and compact button checks
failed_attempts: Earlier failures are retained in session scratch. The partial-visibility drop policy was corrected; the outer-edge fixture now uses the entire desktop boundary and records the actual origin after AppKit rounding. No assertion threshold was relaxed.
